items.title: Scale {{your career}} with Mirakl. Join us in leading the digital transformation of eCommerce.

content.value: Mirakl is the enterprise marketplace SaaS platform leading the digital transformation of eCommerce. If you are passionate about growth and new technology, come join us on our entrepreneurial adventure.
Japan-only text
We are looking for collaborators with diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward.
Always be ready to lend a hand, seek constructive feedback, and embrace differences.
Stay agile, find creative solutions, and move forward step by step while keeping the big picture in mind.
Put yourself in your clients’ shoes, understand the challenges of their business, and become a trusted partner.
Develop your knowledge every day, share your expertise, and pass on your passion.
Innovate to remain the best, always strive to do better, and prioritize quality.

items.quote: I feel fortunate to be surrounded by talented data scientists and data engineers. Together, we explore state-of-the-art models and technologies to offer the best-in-class solutions. It is a stimulating environment where I get to work on a variety of use cases and on the most challenging AI projects one can find!
items.author: Remi Takase

content.value: Inclusive culture, exclusive perks
Innovate with the latest Macbook Pro or Linux PC, dual screens, and a Mirakl technical orientation.
Enjoy breakfast every morning, along with fresh fruits, juice, and hot beverages, as well as monthly Aperos.
Get together for yoga, lunchtime board games, summer BBQs, golf, football, and foosball.
Collaborate in new offices with comfy meeting rooms, a relaxation floor, a furnished terrace & bike parking.
Benefit from one remote work day per week, with a fixed in-office team day (Team Day)
Develop your technical expertise at conferences and training events.

items.quote: It is stimulating to be in a role where you are constantly learning and always encouraged to give your best. Even after a year, I am still learning new things all the time, which keeps the work interesting and continuously creates opportunities for growth. I am grateful to be part of such a great company, where everyone shares the same goal and supports one another.
items.author: Carli Donovan

items.title: Here’s what you can expect when you apply.

content.value: Explore jobs and submit your application online. Our team will review your resume.
If you are selected, you will be invited to a first interview with a recruiter.
If successful, you will then meet the hiring manager and a few future colleagues (on-site or via Zoom). Your expertise and fit with our core values will be assessed.
Interviews will follow the STAR method and assess your skills as well as your alignment with the company’s values.
Your interviewers will debrief internally to discuss all elements of your background. Then you will receive a final decision within two weeks.
Once you accept our offer, we will keep in touch to ease the onboarding process.

items.quote: I started at Mirakl as a Talent Acquisition intern, then continued on a fixed-term contract before joining the Mirakl Connect team as an Account Executive for the German market through an internal mobility opportunity. Almost two years later, what strikes me the most is the company’s dynamic: the product is constantly evolving, and internal opportunities allow you to reinvent yourself and keep learning.
items.author: Sasha Raab
